storage_protocol_zone_acls_configured.title: Storage Protocol Zone-Level ACLs Configured
storage_protocol_zone_acls_configured.description: Indicates whether per-protocol ACLs (covering SMB, NFS, and/or iSCSI) are enforced at the zone boundary firewall or VLAN level to restrict storage session initiation to authorized source zones only.

unauthorized_zone_storage_access_observe.title: Unauthorized Zone Storage Access Observed
unauthorized_zone_storage_access_observe.description: Indicates whether storage protocol sessions (SMB, NFS, iSCSI) have been initiated from hosts in untrusted or adjacent zones not authorized for storage access, based on firewall logs, NAS access logs, or network flow analysis.

nas_vlan_isolation_enforced.title: NAS VLAN Isolation Enforced
nas_vlan_isolation_enforced.description: Indicates whether the NAS resides in a dedicated VLAN with enforced Layer 2/3 isolation preventing direct reachability from untrusted or adjacent VLANs without explicit inter-VLAN firewall policy.

nfs_uid_gid_squashing_enabled.title: NFS UID/GID Squashing Enabled
nfs_uid_gid_squashing_enabled.description: Whether the NFS export is configured to squash client-supplied UID/GID values (e.g., all_squash or root_squash) to prevent arbitrary identity presentation at the trust boundary.

nfs_export_crosses_trust_zone_boundary.title: NFS Export Crosses Trust Zone Boundary
nfs_export_crosses_trust_zone_boundary.description: Whether the NFS export is accessible to clients in a different (lower) trust zone than the NFS server, meaning untrusted clients can send arbitrary UID/GID values.

nfs_auth_mechanism.title: NFS Authentication Mechanism
nfs_auth_mechanism.description: The authentication/security flavor used by the NFS export. Values: 'sys' (AUTH_SYS, no cryptographic validation of UID/GID), 'krb5' (Kerberos authentication only), 'krb5i' (Kerberos with integrity), 'krb5p' (Kerberos with privacy/encryption), 'none' (no authentication).

dedicated_oob_management_network_present.title: Dedicated Out-of-Band Management Network Present
dedicated_oob_management_network_present.description: Indicates whether a dedicated, physically or logically separate out-of-band management network exists for NAS management interfaces, isolated from the data-plane storage client network.

management_interfaces_exposed_on_data_vl.title: NAS Management Interfaces Exposed on Data-Plane VLAN
management_interfaces_exposed_on_data_vl.description: Indicates whether NAS management interfaces (HTTP/S, SNMP, SSH) are bound to or reachable from the same network segment/VLAN used by storage data-plane clients (NFS, SMB, iSCSI).

acl_restricts_mgmt_access_to_admin_hosts.title: ACL Restricts Management Access to Authorized Admin Hosts Only
acl_restricts_mgmt_access_to_admin_hosts.description: Indicates whether network ACLs or firewall rules explicitly restrict access to NAS management interfaces (HTTP/S, SNMP, SSH) to a defined set of authorized administrative hosts or management-plane IP ranges, blocking access from storage data-plane client subnets.

credential_scope_isolation_enforced.title: Credential Scope Isolation Enforced Across Zones
credential_scope_isolation_enforced.description: Indicates whether NAS authentication credentials are scoped and validated independently per trust zone, preventing a credential valid in one zone from being honored in another without re-validation.

shared_credential_zones.title: Trust Zones Sharing NAS Credentials
shared_credential_zones.description: List of trust zone identifiers (e.g., 'dmz', 'internal', 'production', 'development') that share the same service account or domain credential set for NAS share authentication.

nas_zone_boundary_revalidation.title: NAS Credential Re-Validation at Zone Boundaries
nas_zone_boundary_revalidation.description: Describes whether and how credentials are re-validated when NAS access traverses a trust zone boundary.

replication_egress_filtering_enabled.title: Replication Egress Filtering Enabled
replication_egress_filtering_enabled.description: Whether egress filtering (DLP, firewall policy, or inspection rules) is applied to outbound NAS replication and backup traffic (rsync, NDMP, snapshot replication protocols).

replication_destination_zone_validation.title: Replication Destination Zone Validation
replication_destination_zone_validation.description: Whether replication and backup jobs enforce a validated allowlist of permitted destination hosts or trust zones, preventing replication to arbitrary or external endpoints.

replication_traffic_dlp_exempted.title: Replication Traffic DLP Exempted
replication_traffic_dlp_exempted.description: Whether replication or backup traffic has been explicitly exempted from DLP or content inspection policies due to volume, performance, or trusted-service classification.

smb_signing_enforced.title: SMB Signing Enforced
smb_signing_enforced.description: Whether SMB signing is enforced on the NAS device for all connections, preventing NTLM relay attacks by requiring cryptographic message integrity.

ntlm_traffic_blocked_at_boundary.title: NTLM Relay Traffic Blocked at Zone Boundary
ntlm_traffic_blocked_at_boundary.description: Whether the network boundary (firewall/ACL) between the NAS trust zone and adjacent zones blocks NTLM relay-capable traffic (e.g., SMB port 445 ingress from untrusted zones).

cross_zone_authentication_scope.title: Cross-Zone Authentication Scope
cross_zone_authentication_scope.description: Indicates whether the NAS device is configured to participate in authentication contexts that span multiple trust zones, such as being joined to a domain accessible from multiple zones or accepting credentials from multiple zone sources.

iscsi_initiator_acl_enforcement.title: iSCSI Initiator ACL Enforcement
iscsi_initiator_acl_enforcement.description: Indicates whether iSCSI targets restrict connections to explicitly authorized initiator IQNs, or allow any initiator to connect.

chap_authentication_state.title: CHAP Authentication State
chap_authentication_state.description: Describes the state of CHAP authentication on iSCSI targets: absent, present with weak/static shared secrets, or properly configured with per-zone rotated secrets.

lun_masking_zone_aligned.title: LUN Masking Aligned to Trust Zones
lun_masking_zone_aligned.description: Indicates whether LUN masking (storage fabric zoning and host group membership) is configured in alignment with network trust zone boundaries, preventing initiators from one zone accessing LUNs assigned to another zone.

intra_zone_flow_logging_enabled.title: Intra-Zone Flow Logging Enabled
intra_zone_flow_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether flow logging (e.g., NetFlow, sFlow, or equivalent) is enabled for east-west traffic within the storage VLAN or zone, capturing peer-to-peer storage client communications.

anomaly_detection_applied_to_storage_zon.title: Anomaly Detection Applied to Storage Zone
anomaly_detection_applied_to_storage_zon.description: Indicates whether an IDS, NDR, or behavioral analytics solution is actively monitoring and alerting on anomalous traffic patterns (e.g., unusual access volumes, port scans, lateral movement indicators) within the storage VLAN or zone.

anonymous_or_guest_access_enabled.title: Anonymous or Guest Access Enabled on NAS Export
anonymous_or_guest_access_enabled.description: Indicates whether any NAS share or export is configured to permit anonymous or guest access without requiring credentials (e.g., NFS no_root_squash with world-readable exports, SMB guest ok = yes, or AFP guest access).

zone_boundary_ingress_filter_blocks_stor.title: Zone Boundary Ingress Filter Blocks Unauthenticated Storage Protocol Traffic
zone_boundary_ingress_filter_blocks_stor.description: Indicates whether the network zone boundary (firewall, ACL, or security group) enforces ingress rules that block unauthenticated storage protocol traffic (SMB/445, NFS/2049, AFP/548, iSCSI/3260) from adjacent or untrusted zones from reaching the storage zone.

reachable_from_untrusted_or_adjacent_zon.title: NAS Export Reachable from Untrusted or Adjacent Zone
reachable_from_untrusted_or_adjacent_zon.description: Indicates whether the NAS storage system is network-reachable on storage protocol ports from hosts in an untrusted or adjacent network zone (e.g., DMZ, guest VLAN, partner network).
